test_PackTag: test the PackTag function to pack a field number and wire type into a protobuf tag
test_UnpackTag: test the UnpackTag function to unpack a protobuf tag into its field number and wire type
test_ZigZagEncode: test the ZigZagEncode function to encode signed integers for efficient varint encoding in protobuf
test_ZigZagDecode: test the ZigZagDecode function to decode zigzag-encoded values back to signed integers
test_ByteSizeFunctions: test all numeric ByteSize functions including Int32, UInt64, SInt32, Fixed32, Float, and Enum byte size calculations
